data.title: Unit 1 : The Human Body
Brain, Heart and Lungs
data.heading: The heart
data.text: The heart is made up of very strong muscles.
The muscles of the heart squeeze and relax to pump blood to every part of the body.
Blood carries oxygen and all the vitamins and minerals to other parts of the body.
The blood picks up things that the body doesn't need and carries them to the lungs and kidneys, from where they leave the body.
